title: CROSS+WALKRI Runbook Schema (Operator Cohort)
description: The operational procedures the round operates under. Specifies the CLEAR stages with their procedural details, the determination procedures, and the inter-cycle reflection and pre-award indicator confirmation stages. This is the operator-cohort artifact that operationalizes the full CLEAR lifecycle.

commit.description: The funder publishes the obligation architecture. Round-config publication date, runbook publication date, and applicant-facing-publication date all sit in this stage.

list.description: Intake against the published specification. Application open and close dates, declarations required, and disqualification triggers.

evaluate.description: Assessment against the committed criteria. Determination body engagement, scoring procedure, and finding generation.

attest.description: Evidence submitted at completion. Attestation Corpus query procedures, evidence form requirements, and verification steps.

register.description: Outcomes registered into the institutional record. Public publication of determinations, attestation corpus updates, and inter-cycle reflection inputs.

clear_stages.x-cross-walkri-source-section: Primitives Foundation v0.1.6 Foundational Structural Anchors
clear_stages.description: The five stages of the round lifecycle as procedurally specified.

determination_body_reference.description: Reference to the determination body specified in the round-config.

determination_procedures.description: How the determination body operates during the Evaluate stage.

pre_award_indicator_confirmation.description: The stage at which the program confirms with the applicant which indicators of contribution will be measured before evaluation runs.

inter_cycle_reflection.description: Reflection on round outcomes published before the next cycle opens, instantiating pre-commitment as structural posture.
